articles.title: What Labor gains and loses by hiding its fights
articles.summary: The article delves into internal policy disagreements within the Labor party, examining the impact of 'closed-door' conflicts versus public perception. It questions whether such disputes truly 'happen' if not widely known, contrasting the views of internal critics demanding transparency with the external awareness. This highlights a common challenge in political parties regarding accountability and the visibility of internal struggles.

articles.title: New Lanterns Poster Released; Titles And Runtimes For First Four Episodes Revealed
articles.summary: DC Studios released an exclusive poster for its upcoming 'Lanterns' series at San Diego Comic-Con, following an extended trailer that garnered positive fan reception. This promotional push for the highly anticipated show, set within the iconic DC universe, aims to build momentum. The marketing strategy surrounding the series' reveal is crucial in generating excitement among its global fanbase.

articles.title: NBA Eastern Conference Power Rankings: LeBron to Philly moves Sixers behind Knicks in East race
articles.summary: The article speculates on future NBA events, detailing LeBron James' hypothetical move to the Philadelphia 76ers, significantly boosting their title aspirations. It also projects the New York Knicks winning the 2026 NBA championship in a dominant 4-1 series victory. This report highlights potential major shifts in NBA team dynamics and future contenders.

articles.title: Indian Defence Forces fully prepared to face any challenge, says Rajnath Singh on eve of Kargil Vijay Diwas
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh affirmed the Indian Defence Forces' full preparedness to confront any challenge, highlighting the unchanging intentions of adversaries. He stressed the nation's unwavering commitment to safeguarding its sovereignty and integrity, urging preparedness. This reinforces the critical role of a strong military in national security, a key understanding for aspiring SSB candidates.

articles.title: Who Are The Manhunters? HBO's Lanterns Villains, Explained
articles.summary: The origins of Green Lantern’s Manhunter robots date back to a 1977 "Justice League of America" comic by Englehart and Dillin. These robotic antagonists were instrumental in a storyline where they deceived Hal Jordan. This pivotal narrative established early themes of artificial intelligence and technological deception within superhero lore, influencing how advanced robotic threats are portrayed in subsequent fictional universes.

articles.title: PM Modi reviews Assam flood situation as death toll rises to 62; assures Centre's full support
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi reviewed the severe flood situation in Assam, where the devastating floods have tragically claimed 62 lives. Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma communicated developments via a post on X. The Prime Minister's assessment underscores the national focus on providing support and managing the humanitarian impact of the widespread inundation across the state, indicating urgent government attention.
